blocks.html: Where the piping system is connected to appliances or equipment designed for operating pressures equal to or greater than the test pressure, such appliances or equipment shall be isolated from the piping system by closing the individual appliance or equipment shutoff valve(s). The affected piping and joints shall be checked with a noncorrosive leak-detecting fluid or other approved leak-detecting methods when gas is energized.
